stimuli.description: ordinary multicolored images (photos and graphics) from a database of 5000 images, reduced to 70 pixels max dimension for main study

tables.description: Pearson r correlation coefficient and R² correlation between observer judgments and predicted emotion values for heat, weight, and activity

limitations: users may have very different monitor settings
viewing environment (illumination settings, background colors) may vary significantly
psychological state of the user is unknown
image content in general, not only the color content, will affect the user's emotional response
risk that some users will deliberately submit answers disagreeing with their own emotional feelings
